answer: Mechanism: glacier-gated admission. Each new account opens a glacier, a frozen reputation reserve, and stays in an oasis, a capped zone with minimal payout and vote weight. Operation: every honest epoch deposits one ice layer; reserve mass, not account age, sets privileges, and only at a fixed mass may the account cross the admission ridge into full participation. Abuse melts layers ten times faster than they form, and heat cannot transfer between reserves. Cost: N sybils fund N separate glaciers through N full freeze cycles with no bulk discount; honest users cross once.
